hero.tagline: I build things — from terminal games to crypto bots. Here's a look at the projects I'm working on.

about.title: About me
about.body: I'm a developer who likes building things from scratch — especially in the terminal. From role-playing games and card games to a crypto arbitrage bot and handy scripts, I enjoy turning ideas into working code. Always learning, always shipping.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.body: Want to talk, collaborate or just say hi? Reach out.

terminal-rpg.title: Terminal RPG
terminal-rpg.short: A role-playing game you play entirely in the terminal.
terminal-rpg.long: A text-based role-playing game that runs in the terminal. Explore, fight enemies and level up your character through a command-line interface, with game state, combat and progression all handled in code.

crypto-arbitrage-bot.title: Crypto Arbitrage Bot
crypto-arbitrage-bot.short: A crypto arbitrage bot built during a hackathon.
crypto-arbitrage-bot.long: A trading bot built at a hackathon that scans crypto markets for arbitrage opportunities — price differences across exchanges or pairs — and reacts to them automatically. Focused on fetching live market data and acting on profitable spreads.

solitaire-cli.title: Solitaire CLI
solitaire-cli.short: A solitaire card game playable in the terminal.
solitaire-cli.long: A solitaire (patience) card game that runs in the terminal, built as a university project (LI2). Implements the full card game logic — deck, stacks, moves and win conditions — with a text-based interface.

background-remover.title: Background Remover
background-remover.short: A script that removes the background from photos.
background-remover.long: A script that automatically removes the background from images, isolating the subject. Useful for product photos, avatars and quick edits without opening a heavy image editor.

resell-tracker.title: Resell Tracker
resell-tracker.short: A tool to track reselling items, costs and profit.
resell-tracker.long: A tracker for reselling: keep tabs on items, buying costs, selling prices and profit over time. Helps see what's worth flipping and how the numbers add up.
